name: site-v5
description: The real site built on Quartz Core: the workspace package the site loads its plugins through. Repo-only: never published (CONTEXT.md).
//dependencies: Every plugin the site and the e2e fixture list by package name, linked from the workspace. Quartz imports a package source by name from Core source, and Node's upward walk from quartz-v5/core/quartz/ reaches this package's node_modules, so Core's own package.json stays upstream's (#89, #93, VENDORED.md). Plugins not yet converted load by local path (#94, #95).
